stage.note: Full-canvas stage cuts (1320x743, figure pre-placed) built 2026-11-08 from the consistent expressions-v1 set (~/workspace/nira-avatar/expressions-v1/, img2img from the master; v2 variants for reading/serious/apology) - the earlier v6-pack cuts were a mismatched set and are no longer used on stage. Mapping stage->v1: onair=01-onair, reading=02-reading-v2, serious=03-serious-v2, disappointed=04-quiet, gloomy=04-quiet, sorrowful=04-quiet, embarrassed=05-smile, energetic=06-greeting, breaking=07-breaking, sleepy=09-sleepy, apologetic=10-apology-v2, surprised=11-surprise, closing=12-closing, laughing=13-laugh, listening=14-explain, puzzled=16-exasperated (fallback, see inspection note), skeptical=16-exasperated, warm=17-empathy. V10 REBUILD 2026-11-08 (owner's method, after the v8 stage showed the figure floating on the desk and a see-through wedge in the right hair on a real-device screenshot): layer order is room (character/room-layer.jpg) -> figure -> desk foreground. The desk foreground character/desk-fg-v10.png is cut from the SAME room-layer.jpg pixels (full-width band from the desk back edge y=568 down, plus the silhouette of the mug that overlaps the figure, x380-459/y521-599), so on its opaque pixels the final composite is pixel-identical to the room alone (verified max diff 0); the figure's lower body is occluded by it and she reads as sitting behind the desk. Figure placement is the approved composite-tune-master-S transform, reverse-engineered by IoU fit of the master cutout against master-S (IoU 0.9702): source canvas scaled 0.442, offset (422,74); measured on the baked frames: alpha bbox x422-700, hair top y105-107 (master-S: x422-696, top y107), figure bottom y610 occluded at y568. Cutouts were re-made from the expressions-v1 originals: border flood fill (tolerance 22) + morphological opening (r=5) of the exterior mask to sever the narrow leaks that had eaten the pale hair sheen (the v8 defect: the sheen is near-background in colour, so plain colour keying removed it - worst onair 4011px, laughing 2246px, skeptical 2124px in the old bake), then largest-component cleanup (stray corner blobs removed). No colour grade and no baked contact shadow in v10 (the v8 'warm grade' was CSS brightness only). Rebuild: tools-local/stage-v10/bake.py 0.442 422 74. applyStageFace only swaps src. INSPECTION 2026-11-08 (~/workspace/nira-avatar/expressions-unified-v1/inspection.md): 15-question is BANNED from the stage - its eyes are flat green rectangles with no pupil structure (worst breakage in the set) - so 'puzzled' falls back to 16-exasperated (shared with 'skeptical'); the baked stage/full/puzzled.png was removed and the v1 cutout is kept only as source material. 02-reading-v2 and 10-apology-v2 have flat mint-fill eyes (moderate): usable, but avoid long consecutive use. 04-quiet, 07-breaking and 14-explain have weak dot mouths (minor-moderate): kept. Good frames: 01-onair, 05-smile, 12-closing; the standard/default expression of this pack is 01-onair (the 'onair' entry). Note: the player's shared initial face stays 'serious' because the 2D bust pack (frames/) has no 'onair' cut - align both packs to 01 at the next pack rebuild. Hair colour varies across frames (blue-black / grey / green-teal families): a known trait of the source set, accepted for now, no regeneration.
